svg.title: Cold-room response to a manual command and an open door
svg.desc: Refrigeration ON for 20 seconds lowers the temperature from 4.00 to 0.84 degrees Celsius; with refrigeration OFF it rises, faster while the door is open from 60 to 90 seconds; the command does not react.
svg.text: What the cold room did in the manual experiment
Simulator run of this project · 0.1 s samples · numbers answer the predictions
The command stays OFF while the room warms
